CustomMetadata.label: Tell people when their long jobs finish

values.value: When someone starts a long job by hand, such as an import, a bulk update or delete, an undo, the sample data load or a rollup recalculation, BarnCRM sends them a notification under the bell when it finishes or stops, with the counts and a link to the job. Scheduled nightly and weekly runs never send one. Clear this to stop the notifications for everyone; the jobs run and record their results exactly as before.
